sn4.10:2.1: appam idaṃ bhikkhave manussānam āyu || gamanīyo samparāyo || || kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ || natthi jātassa amaraṇam || yo bhikkhave ciraṃ jīvati so vassasatam appaṃ vā bhīyo ti || ||
sn4.10:3.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.10:4.1: Nāccayanti ahorattā || jīvitaṃ n-uparujjhati || āyu anupariyāti maccānaṃ || nemi va ratha-kubbaran ti ||
sn4.10:5.1: Accayanti ahorattā || jīvitam uparujjhati || āyu khīyati maccānam || kunnadīnam va odakan ti || ||
sn4.10:6.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tath-ev-antaradhāyī ti || || Pathamo vaggo ||
sn4.10:7.0: Tass-uddānam || || Tapo-kammañ ca Nāgo ca || Subhaṃ Pāsena te duve || Sappo Suppati Nandanaṃ || Āyunā apare duve ti || || ___________________________________________
